notes.subject: tsedek i lukluk
notes.rationale: צדיק הראשון בריבו: 'i lukluk olsem tsedek' (seemeth just, KJV/JPS) o 'em i tsedek tru' (ylt); Hebrem i tok tsedek tasol, bracket i soim pasin bilong lukluk

notes.subject: i go daunbilo long
notes.rationale: חקר i tok 'go insaid na skelim', Tok Pisin i bruikim long tupela tok

translation: Tsedek ⟨i lukluk⟩ long man i tok tok bilong en pastaim long pait bilong en; tasol pren bilong em i kam, na i skelim ⟨i go daunbilo long⟩ ol tok bilong em.
